city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula providing comfort and support to a pregnant mom in Frisco with warm golden light
city_fields.culture: Frisco is one of the fastest-growing cities in America, known for its family-friendly communities, excellent schools, and world-class sports facilities including The Star (Dallas Cowboys headquarters). The city's diverse population includes a large South Asian community, and many doulas in the area offer culturally responsive care. Frisco's birth community is anchored by the Frisco Midwifery and Birth Center, which has created a collaborative network of midwives, doulas, and birth professionals serving the DFW metroplex.
city_fields.medicaidNote: Yes — Texas Medicaid covers doula services through the Healthy Texas Women program. Contact your Medicaid managed care plan for specific coverage details and approved doula providers in the Frisco area.
